_meta.what: MD send plan: one verified brief a day, in queue order (intel.send_plan)
_meta.rule: one send to the MD per London day; only briefs that pass every gate (verified, audit pass, 2 pages, PDF, not held, not already sent)
_meta.how: python -m intel.send_plan --list | --add N --note … | --hold N | --release N | --remove N | --dry-run | --send. The daily-send workflow runs --send at 07:00 London; the Send-a-brief button and intel.resend record into 'sent' as well.
